title: Carpal Tunnel Syndrome
subtitle: What carpal tunnel syndrome is, causes, risk factors, symptoms, evaluation, management, lifestyle considerations, and safety.
evidence_strength: Established Evidence: Diagnosis, risk factors, and conservative management of CTS are strongly supported by clinical guidelines and systematic reviews. Surgical treatment efficacy is well established but individualized. Emerging Evidence: Ergonomic interventions show promise but require further high-quality studies. Uncertain Evidence: Long-term outcomes of some treatments vary based on patient factors.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
